scoring_rules.criterion_points: integer 0-5 = count of passed binary checks
scoring_rules.category_points: integer 0-20 = sum of its four criteria

model_verdict.note: Separate verdict; contributes zero engineering points; positive alpha earns no bonus.

hard_caps.description: cherry-picking or presenting train/val as OOS

A1.title: Freshness-aware run lifecycle status

checks.contract: Run discovery/detail derives LIVE only from an explicit running state plus an advancing event file within two poll intervals; finished/stale/replay runs are typed COMPLETED/STALE/REPLAY, never LIVE.
checks.happy_test: Automated test proves a running, advancing stream renders RUNNING then deterministically transitions to COMPLETED.
checks.failure_test: Automated test proves a static historical JSONL (rows present, no advance) renders STALE/REPLAY and never LIVE.
checks.runtime_evidence: Live browser capture records at least two advancing steps and the RUNNING->COMPLETED/STALE transition on the real built surface.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms no polling/row-presence/fetch-time path can mark LIVE, and the API fixture + capture bundle hash is recorded.

A1.required_evidence: API fixture + live browser transition capture

A2.title: Explicit action availability and metric kind/unit

checks.contract: Adapters preserve null action as NOT_RECORDED/-- and carry explicit reward_kind/reward_unit/equity_kind/equity_unit; no null-to-zero/HOLD coercion exists.
checks.happy_test: Automated test proves a stream declaring units renders the declared reward/equity kind and unit correctly.
checks.failure_test: Automated test proves a null-action row renders NOT_RECORDED and a cross-unit overlay (NAV vs KRW) is rejected/separated.
checks.runtime_evidence: Populated UI capture shows NOT_RECORDED and declared units on real data through the built surface.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms schema/adapter tests plus UI capture, and records the evidence bundle hash.

A3.title: Authoritative test-OOS latest/today selection

checks.contract: latest/today selection uses explicit authority/status/completion (mtime only as final tie-break), test OOS is primary, and disposable smoke cannot become production latest.
checks.happy_test: Isolated-root API test proves a canonical test-OOS run wins latest and today matches date/policy/split/authority.
checks.failure_test: Isolated-root API test proves a newer disposable smoke or older/first-aggregate row cannot steal latest/primary.
checks.runtime_evidence: Canonical-vs-smoke scenario on the real surface shows the authoritative test-OOS headline, not the smoke.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms isolated-root tests and the canonical/smoke scenario, recording the bundle hash.

A3.required_evidence: isolated-root API tests + canonical/smoke failure scenario

A4.title: Selected-run verdict, blockers, and freshness visibility

checks.contract: Selected-run payload surfaces verdict, the full API blocker list, D0/D1/D5, cost, seed, split, and artifact freshness without hardcoded counts/text.
checks.happy_test: Automated payload assertion proves verdict/blockers/seed/split/cost/date/artifact-age are present for a selected run.
checks.failure_test: Automated test proves a run with a different blocker list is not rendered with a hardcoded count or stale normalization text.
checks.runtime_evidence: Selected-run browser capture shows the verdict/blocker/freshness fields populated from the API on the real surface.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms payload assertion + browser capture and records the bundle hash.

B1.title: Responsive fit and CJK integrity on four audited pages

checks.contract: Four audited pages use controlled widths/tokens so content fits 375/768/1280 in light/dark with no clipping or CJK collapse.
checks.happy_test: Automated DOM measurement asserts scrollWidth<=clientWidth for four pages x three widths x two themes.
checks.failure_test: Automated fixture injects an overlong Korean run ID and rejects overflow or one-character collapse.
checks.runtime_evidence: 24 fresh production-build captures (4 pages x 3 widths x 2 themes) show no overflow/clipping.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent visual reviewer confirms the measurements and 24 captures and records the bundle hash.

B2.title: WCAG AA contrast, keyboard, and chart alternatives

checks.contract: Text/status controls meet AA contrast; interactive elements expose aria state and focus-visible order; charts provide a text/data alternative.
checks.happy_test: axe/DOM assertions pass for contrast, aria-pressed/state, and focus order on the audited pages.
checks.failure_test: Automated test proves a chart without an accessible name/summary/data alternative fails the a11y gate.
checks.runtime_evidence: Keyboard-only traversal trace reaches and announces every interactive control on the real surface.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms axe results + keyboard trace and records the bundle hash.

checks.contract: Run selection uses request-generation/abort tokens and each card owns independent loading/error/empty/stale state so mixed state cannot render.
checks.happy_test: Delayed/out-of-order request test proves rapidly switching runs ends with only the newest run's data.
checks.failure_test: Automated test proves a stalled non-critical endpoint renders ERROR/RETRY for that card while others hydrate (not MISSING).
checks.runtime_evidence: Browser trace under injected latency shows no mixed-run state and per-card independent states.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the race test + browser trace and records the bundle hash.

B4.title: Quantitative page and API latency targets

checks.contract: Critical loaders are split and backend validation/tail reads are bounded/memoized so latency targets are achievable.
checks.happy_test: Repeatable timing script asserts first meaningful card <=3s and full critical hydration <=10s on the recorded corpus.
checks.failure_test: Timing test proves a warm critical API breaching <=2s (or cold <=5s) fails the latency gate rather than passing silently.
checks.runtime_evidence: JSON timing results from the representative corpus record the measured card/API latencies.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the timing script + JSON results and records the bundle hash.

C1.title: Honest close-slot CLI accounting and identity

checks.contract: The standard close-slot CLI writes live events, reserves buy-side costs when sizing, honors the documented tie-break, and uses honest algorithm identity (no misused contextual-bandit label).
checks.happy_test: Unit/integration tests prove cash reserves buy costs, tie_score is deterministic, and the default CLI emits truthful events.
checks.failure_test: Test proves an aggregate-positive/test-negative fixture cannot obtain GO or a primary positive headline.
checks.runtime_evidence: Bounded real-data smoke manifest shows nonempty truthful events and a complete test ledger.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms tests + smoke manifest and records the bundle hash.

C2.title: Genuine daily R3b SB3 adapter and training path

checks.contract: A daily R3b adapter maps official daily predictions with 23bp defaults, fold-specific fit, configurable device, and a >=200k/seed path distinct from the tabular lane.
checks.happy_test: E2E test trains a short test model through the adapter and discovers it under the default dashboard root.
checks.failure_test: Test proves shuffled/missing-hash/wrong-cost input fails before model.learn.
checks.runtime_evidence: Real model artifact, events, and device/lineage summary exist for the 5k smoke and the full path.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms adapter tests + artifact/lineage summary and records the bundle hash.

C2.required_evidence: tests, model artifact, events, device/lineage summary

checks.contract: R5 produces deterministic pretrained/finetuned/random zero-shot comparison and base-vs-finetuned tokenizer reconstruction on the exact lineage.
checks.happy_test: Deterministic rerun yields identical comparison metrics within the preregistered tolerance.
checks.failure_test: Corrupt/missing comparison input returns INCONCLUSIVE without interpreting partial metrics.
checks.runtime_evidence: Dated result + JSON with seed42/sample5, reconstruction MSE, and input/output hashes exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the deterministic result + hashes and records the bundle hash.

C4.title: Authoritative multi-seed governance consumers

checks.contract: Registry/aliases, the R6 sweep, optional Aim, and R7 rliable consume authoritative identical-config multi-seed outputs only.
checks.happy_test: Test proves the registry returns one authoritative row per real run and rliable accepts only identical-config seeds.
checks.failure_test: Test proves duplicate run IDs from one seed are rejected as rliable/seed inputs.
checks.runtime_evidence: SQLite query, stability JSON, Aim capture, and IQM/CI report from the real seeds exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the governance consumers + reports and records the bundle hash.

C4.required_evidence: SQLite query, stability JSON, Aim capture, IQM/CI report

D1.title: Preregistration, cost controls, and chronological hygiene

checks.contract: Each experiment has a prereg, 23bp primary with 0/46 controls, chronological purge/embargo, and recorded seed and source hashes.
checks.happy_test: Manifest/gate validation passes for a compliant run (prereg + 23bp/0/46 + purge/embargo + hashes).
checks.failure_test: Validation rejects a run missing prereg, controls, embargo, or source hashes.
checks.runtime_evidence: Real manifest/gate output records the prereg reference, controls, and hashes.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the manifest/gate validation and records the bundle hash.

checks.contract: Test OOS plus no-trade, momentum/RULE, buy-hold where relevant, and shuffle/negative controls are all present for alpha claims.
checks.happy_test: Baseline/control tables assert every required baseline and control is computed on test OOS.
checks.failure_test: Gate proves an alpha claim missing a shuffle/negative control or the test-OOS baseline fails.
checks.runtime_evidence: Real baseline/control tables and gate results exist for the evaluated run.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms baseline/control coverage and records the bundle hash.

checks.contract: >=3 identical-config SB3 seeds plus the planned 5x3 D4 sweep report MDD and bootstrap uncertainty.
checks.happy_test: Stability report reproduces one seed summary from raw ledgers and aggregates all seeds.
checks.failure_test: Test proves a seed with negative test OOS or high MDD cannot be omitted from the aggregate.
checks.runtime_evidence: Real stability and rliable reports with IQM/CI and MDD exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms stability/rliable reproducibility and records the bundle hash.

checks.contract: Artifact promotion is explicit/hashable; NO-GO/NON_IMPROVING is never softened; a positive result earns no bonus.
checks.happy_test: Promotion-manifest test proves canonical promotion is explicit and verdict-labeled.
checks.failure_test: Audit proves a softened NO-GO or an unlabeled bulk promotion is rejected.
checks.runtime_evidence: Real promotion manifest + docs/AGENTS honesty audit output exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms promotion + honesty audit and records the bundle hash.

E1.title: Green tests, build, and changed-file static checks

checks.contract: Targeted and full tests, npm check/build, and changed-file LSP/static checks are wired and runnable.
checks.happy_test: Targeted + full pytest and npm check/build pass with recorded logs/JUnit.
checks.failure_test: A deliberately failing test/build or error-severity diagnostic causes the gate to fail (no suppression).
checks.runtime_evidence: Real logs/JUnit/LSP JSON/build hashes from this SHA exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the logs/JUnit/LSP/build evidence and records the bundle hash.

checks.contract: Loopback binding, restricted CORS/path roots, debug-off default, sanitized docs, and bounded heavy inputs are enforced.
checks.happy_test: Security tests prove an allowed root + loopback origin succeeds.
checks.failure_test: Security tests reject arbitrary absolute paths, disallowed origins, oversized params, and remote debug.
checks.runtime_evidence: Runtime probes confirm debug off, loopback binding, and inert docs rendering.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent security reviewer confirms tests + probes and records the bundle hash.

checks.contract: No high/critical advisories remain; production-reachable moderates are fixed or explicitly isolated with owner/deadline.
checks.happy_test: npm audit --json shows zero high/critical (or an explicit 90-gate temporary reachability disposition).
checks.failure_test: An unmitigated production-reachable moderate without owner/deadline fails the disposition check.
checks.runtime_evidence: Real npm audit/outdated output plus the disposition record exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms the audit + disposition and records the bundle hash.

E4.title: Clean release state and final reviews

checks.contract: Clean tree, source/generated separation, and a current dated handoff are in place.
checks.happy_test: Git audit proves a clean tree and source/generated separation at the release SHA.
checks.failure_test: A dirty tree, bulk generated commit, or ack-only reviewer fails the release check.
checks.runtime_evidence: Final four review receipts and two visual review receipts (all APPROVE) exist.
checks.independent_review_hash: Independent reviewer confirms git audit + all reviewer receipts and records the bundle hash.
